Class ClearCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.ClearCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class ClearCommand extends Object implements Command
The ClearCommand type is the clear command. The alias is history clear. The command drops user and assistant turns and keeps a configured system prompt. A blank prompt leaves no system frame. The session stays alive.
